title: Descrambler
text: Descramble input signal, 3 inputs, 1 output, {Scramble polynomial} sets Polynomial that defines connections in descrambler ’1 + x^-1 + x^-2 +; {Calculation base}, {Initial states source} sets the source for descrambler initial states, {Initial states} and {Reset on nonzero input via port} sets the reset descrambler via input port. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Scramble polynomial
params.values: Polynomial that defines connections in descrambler ’1 + x^-1 + x^-2 + x^-4’ (default) | character vector | integer vector | binary vector

params.name: Initial states source
params.values: Set the source for descrambler initial states Dialog Parameter (default) | Input port

params.name: Initial states
params.values: Initial states of descrambler registers [0 1 2 3] (default) | nonnegative integer vector

params.name: Reset on nonzero input via port
params.values: Reset descrambler via input port off (default) | on
